What should I do if the website is not working?

First check your internet connection. You can also refresh the page or restart your browser. Reload the website or reopen it.

Which browser can I use?

You can use modern browsers such as Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, or Safari. I use Google Chrome, which is the most reliable, but all the others work well too.

What is HTML?

HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It is used to create and structure web pages, as I am doing.

What payment methods are accepted?

Different payment methods may be available depending on the service. Common methods include cards and online payments like JazzCash, Easypaisa, UPaisa and similar services.

How can I request a refund?

You can contact the support team and provide your payment details, the reason, and proof of payment for the refund request.

Where can I find my invoice?

Your invoice can usually be found in your account's billing or payment section.
